matched: Heinz was an enduring branded-food business suited to long ownership. → The company sells branded packaged food globally, with a focus on sauces and iconic products that consumers have relied on for generations.

The 3G partnership paired operating expertise with Berkshire capital. → We are backing 3G Capital, led by Jorge Paulo Lemann and his partners, who have an exceptional record of driving operational efficiency and improving margins through zero-based budgeting.
The preferred supplied a 9% contractual yield alongside common ownership. → We have stepped in as a financier, securing terms that provide a 9% cumulative dividend on our $8bn preferred investment.
